headline: HuyenBao v11.19 — toast queue + birth day column + reincarnate-licence fix + real market prices + crypto hook
summary: Six targeted fixes per player feedback: (1) Footer text corrected — was 'Time pauses while the tab is closed.' (misleading), now '30s = 1 day online · 10 min = 1 day offline (with risks)' in EN/VI/ZH. (2) Toast queue — previously rapid showToast() calls from tick() (which can return up to 5–10 toasts at once for milestones + ambient events) overwrote each other and the player saw only the last one flash by; now toasts are queued via a ref + drain effect, each shows for its full adaptive duration (3.5–8s) before the next appears. Fixes the 'I see only one quick flash that doesn't lead anywhere' complaint. (3) Reincarnate-licence bug fixed — previously licences had a ~50% chance to survive reincarnation, but the licence UI then showed them as '✓ Done' (disabled, can't re-enroll). Now ALL licences are wiped on reincarnation (true fresh start) — the player can re-enroll any of them. (4) Birth day column added next to birth month in the Intro — previously day=15 was hard-coded; now the player picks 1–31, stored on GameState as birthDay (backfilled in migrate), and feeds the Spirit tab panels (Tử Vi / Phong Thuỷ seed day from s.birthDay instead of 15) and the zodiac calc. (5) Intro disclaimer render fixed — wider container + lineHeight + overflowWrap so the long Vietnamese disclaimer doesn't render as a tall narrow column of single characters on small screens. (6) Market section: base stock prices updated to real-world late-2024 levels (TECH ~$230 large-cap, OIL ~$75, COIN ~$95 BTC proxy, AI ~$580 frontier) + crypto hook link to https://elliott.huyenbao.com/ for the dedicated Elliott Wave crypto companion app + note explaining prices are real-world-inspired but in-game movement is a deterministic random walk per game-day. 4 Huyen-Hoc-AI features (Kinh Dịch / Tử Vi / Phong Thuỷ / Tarot) unchanged.
features: Footer text corrected: '30s = 1 day online · 10 min = 1 day offline (with risks)' — replaces misleading 'Time pauses while the tab is closed.'

Toast queue: rapid showToast() calls no longer overwrite each other; each toast displays for its full adaptive duration (3.5–8s) before the next appears, via a ref-tracked 'showing' flag + drain effect
Reincarnate-licence bug fixed: ALL licences wiped on reincarnation (was ~50% keep chance, which left players unable to re-enroll surviving licences)
Birth day column added next to birth month in the Intro (1–31 select); stored on GameState as birthDay (default 15, backfilled in migrate); feeds Tử Vi + Phong Thuỷ panel day inputs + zodiac calc
Intro disclaimer render fixed: wider container + lineHeight 1.5 + overflowWrap so the long Vietnamese disclaimer doesn't render as a narrow column of single characters on small screens
Market: stock base prices updated to real-world late-2024 levels (TECH $100→$230, OIL $40→$75, COIN $20→$95 BTC proxy, AI $150→$580, SOLAR vol bumped, etc.)
Crypto hook: link button in StockTab → https://elliott.huyenbao.com/ (companion Elliott Wave crypto app) + note that COIN in-game is a BTC proxy + real-prices disclaimer
Version bumped to v11.19 at FRONT of app name (v11.19 HuyenBao)
